_notes: Keep ONE of the two kite entries below. Checked against github.com/zerodha/kite-mcp-server on 2026-10-28.

kite: the hosted server at https://mcp.kite.trade/mcp. No install and no API key: you log in to Kite in the browser when the login tool asks. Its README says the hosted server leaves out place_order, modify_order and cancel_order, so it can read quotes, orders and positions but cannot place an order.

kite-self-hosted: build zerodha/kite-mcp-server yourself (go build -o kite-mcp-server) with your own Kite Connect API key and secret. Type them into this file only, never into the chat. It carries place_order, modify_order and cancel_order.

After a restart, open Customize > Connectors > kite and set place_order, modify_order and cancel_order to Needs approval (place_gtt_order, modify_gtt_order and delete_gtt_order too). Never Always allow.
Kite has no paper account. Keep "broker": "paper" in nse/config.json until you mean real money.
